description: This file is a Python script responsible for generating Markdown documentation files from header files and JSON files within a project. It includes functions for converting header files to Markdown, converting JSON plugin specifications to Markdown, and postprocessing the generated Markdown files to clean up links and sections.

methods.name: generate_md(logfile=None)
methods.description: Main function to generate Markdown files for all plugins, either from header files or JSON files.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md(plugin_path)
methods.description: Converts plugin JSON specifications into Markdown documentation.

methods.name: convert_h_to_md(plugin_path, logfile=None)
methods.description: Converts header files into Markdown documentation.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Post-processes generated Markdown files to remove certain HTML tags and keywords for cleaner documentation.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point of the script; sets up argument parsing and runs documentation generation and post-processing.
